subject: Original GPT-6 Astra 200-game run, context hypothesis

method.promptMeasure: Input tokens per native model-response usage record, including cached input. This measures input length, not how much was attended to or retained correctly.
method.noteReadDetector: Statically extract literal cmd arguments and classify nonmutating cat/tail/head/sed/rg or Python printed file reads. No historical commands executed. Dynamic and indirect reads may not be captured.
method.noteOutputScope: Whole observable exec results in note-reading batches; includes accompanying rules/goal/trial/PGN output. Not an exact count of journal tokens.
method.postCompactionScope: Next five accepted own benchmark moves after a compaction, counted globally across benchmark games; practice moves are excluded. Material-loss proxy is not an engine judgment; observations are clustered and exploratory.

limitations: No randomisation or controlled replay; prompt size, game stage, procedures and game outcome can affect each other.
Summary fidelity and loss of useful facts cannot be established from timestamps and lengths; summary text is not inspected.
A large disk journal is not evidence that its entire contents were loaded into each prompt.
Input-token totals include all model responses during a game and may include compaction/overhead, not solely move decisions.
This analysis describes one evolving agent and does not show degradation of model weights.
